title: Newborn hearing screening
what: A quick hearing test for your baby. A soft tip goes into the ear, the device plays quiet sounds and records the ear's response.
why: For all newborns, usually in the maternity ward in the first days or within the first month.
duration: usually 5 to 10 minutes; the result is ready right away
tell_doctor: Any hearing problems from childhood in the family
If your baby was born early or was in intensive care
If the mother had infections during pregnancy
If your baby had strong antibiotics

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Best when your baby is asleep or calm. It helps to feed your baby before the test.

prepare.title: Quiet
prepare.text: The test is done in a quiet place. Noise and crying affect the result.

bring: Your baby's documents or hospital discharge papers
steps: You hold your baby, or they are placed in a cot
A small soft tip is placed in the ear
The device plays quiet clicks and records the response
The same is done for the other ear
The device shows right away: pass, or a repeat test is needed
feel: It does not hurt. Many babies sleep through it
Your baby may fuss a little if they wake up
after: You get the result right away
A refer result does not mean your baby cannot hear. Fluid or wax in the ear often gets in the way
If your baby does not pass, the test is repeated in a few weeks, or you are referred to a hearing specialist

faq.q: My baby did not pass. Are they deaf?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Often it is fluid after birth or noise. The test will be repeated, with a hearing specialist if needed.
The earlier hearing loss is found, the better speech develops with support.

faq.q: Can it be done if my baby is crying?
faq.a: Better to wait until they calm down. Crying disturbs the device.

reminders.text: Your baby's hearing test is soon. Feed them beforehand, so they are calm or asleep.
